feed.headline: Watch: Will Ukraine get the support needed as tensions with US rise?
feed.ai: Zelensky thanked the "real leaders" ahead of a meeting with the EU in Brussels.

feed.headline: Trump’s Push for Deals With Russia Powers His Frustration With Ukraine
feed.ai: The series of recent steps by the president that seem to favor Vladimir Putin reflect his intensifying desire to normalize the relationship with Moscow even if it means further undercutting Ukraine.

feed.headline: Zelensky Says Trump Risks ‘Historic Mistake’ If He Backs Russia
feed.ai: President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine pressed Sunday for more information on possible restrictions to Starshield, a U.S.-provided satellite internet service used by the Ukrainian military.

feed.headline: Catalonia's former rebel president can return to Spain, court rules
feed.ai: The court upholds a decision to lift an arrest warrant for Carles Puigdemont linked to the independence bid he led in 2017.

feed.headline: Are the French riots a warning of an intense election to come?
feed.ai: Rioting, looting and vandalism has gripped France over the weekend after protests spiralled out of control across the country.

feed.headline: UK to Headphone Dodgers on Trains: Shush
feed.ai: Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced a campaign against listening to music or videos without headphones on public transportation. We asked London commuters to weigh in.

feed.headline: Trump Says He Asked Putin to Release an American Jailed in Russia
feed.ai: The president called for the return of Stephen James Hubbard, a Michigan teacher seized from his home in Ukraine months after Russia invaded that country.

feed.headline: Why Zelensky Took the Gloves Off This Time With Trump
feed.ai: Staying quiet is riskier than speaking up, Ukrainian officials say, as President Trump goes further than ever in prioritizing Russia’s interests.

feed.headline: More Russians are settling in the EU with each year of war in Ukraine
feed.ai: Eurostat data show 876,600 Russian nationals held valid EU residence permits at the end of 2025, with Germany, Spain and Estonia hosting the largest communities.

feed.headline: New Romanian prime minister Luca Niculescu and cabinet members sworn in
feed.ai: Independent diplomat Luca Niculescu wins parliamentary backing for a minority government, but analysts warn the calm may not last.

feed.headline: France's Macron begins state visit to Qatar as part of wider Gulf tour
feed.ai: Qatar welcomed the French president with full state honours on his arrival in Doha as the two countries are strengthening their strategic ties. Facing protests at home, Macron is seeking energy deals with Gulf partners to help ease fuel prices in France, but also contributing to regional stability.

feed.headline: Qatar revamped its entire defence system in six hours, intelligence chief reveals
feed.ai: At Doha’s Global Security Forum, Qatar’s head of intelligence revealed how the war with Iran forced the Gulf country to urgently redeploy its defensive assets, while the US ambassador to Turkey offered new insights into a fundamental shift in Washington's presence in the Middle East.
